newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring wheat bids lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat -Spring wheat bids lower.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring wheat were mostly lower Friday in line with modest losses on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange, grain dealers said.
"With the weakness on the board, there were no farmer sales today," said one Montana dealer.
MGE wheat settled five to 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with July down 3-3/4 at $3.79 and September down 2-1/2 at $3.70 per bushel.
Activity was also quiet ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's wheat acreage forecast on Monday, dealers said.
The average trade estimate for durum wheat is 3.2 million acres from a range of 2.9 to 3.3 million acres.
The average trade estimate for other spring wheat is 18.1 million acres, in a range of 17.6 to 18.8 million.
